title_ru: Simptomat × TACHYON — память, временная последовательность и сохранённая осознанность
scientific_question: Может ли наблюдаемая вовлечённость при текущем событии сохраняться, когда способность упорядочивать или позднее воспроизводить события нарушается? Можно ли различить это, не называя потерю памяти физической вневременностью?

scientific_foundations.title: Altered Time Awareness in Dementia
scientific_foundations.role: AD and FTD have related but partially different profiles of event ordering, interval estimation and personal temporal awareness
scientific_foundations.limitations: Caregiver semi-structured reports; cannot infer retained consciousness from questionnaire alone

scientific_foundations.title: Time Perception and Memory in Mild Cognitive Impairment and Alzheimer's Disease: A Preliminary Study
scientific_foundations.role: Evaluate simultaneity/temporal-order judgments separately from episodic-memory impairment
scientific_foundations.limitations: 11 usable patient participants and 13 comparators; a marginal between-group measure (reported p=0.15) is not statistically conclusive

scientific_foundations.title: Time distortions in Alzheimer’s disease: a systematic review and theoretical integration
scientific_foundations.role: Separate duration estimation, event ordering, retrospective remembering, prospective timing
scientific_foundations.limitations: Review is not evidence of physically timeless consciousness

scientific_foundations.title: Subjective Time in Dementia: A Critical Review
scientific_foundations.role: Heterogeneous temporal cognition and autobiographical/future thinking across dementias
scientific_foundations.limitations: Affect, attention, aphasia, executive functioning and disease heterogeneity confound conclusions

scientific_foundations.title: Alzheimer's Disease Fact Sheet
scientific_foundations.role: Alzheimer is a neurodegenerative condition; do not present pathology as a controllable switch for time travel
scientific_foundations.limitations: Not a protocol for diagnosis by software

mechanistic_competitors.mechanism: Current encoding/attention failure leads to both immediate and later missing material
mechanistic_competitors.key_pattern: Low online engagement or immediate recognition plus low later recall

mechanistic_competitors.mechanism: Preserved online engagement and immediate identity recognition but impaired temporal ordering
mechanistic_competitors.key_pattern: High task engagement and immediate recognition, low order accuracy, adequate delayed item recall

mechanistic_competitors.mechanism: Preserved online engagement and order at encoding but poor delayed retrieval
mechanistic_competitors.key_pattern: High engagement, immediate recognition and order; low delayed recall

mechanistic_competitors.mechanism: Order and episodic retrieval both weak despite preserved immediate encoding indicators
mechanistic_competitors.key_pattern: High engagement/immediate recognition, low temporal ordering and low delayed recall

mechanistic_competitors.mechanism: Subject reports absent passage of time; needs simultaneous independent engagement evidence and strict distinction from amnesia/attention failure
Measurements show no predeclared separation; apparent effect is sampling/attention or absent
mechanistic_competitors.key_pattern: No clear pattern or intervals too broad

tasks.what: Observable engagement with predeclared, non-distressing present-moment cues; a behavioral correlate, not direct measurement of consciousness
Recognition of the just-experienced stimulus items without later-memory requirement
Choose the relative order of separately identifiable events; not the same as their identities
Retrieve item identities after a delay, separately from order and duration
Optional estimate of elapsed duration against an external clock
Optional subjective narrative of passage or no-passage; not scored as diagnosis or proof

controlled_synthetic_protocol.clock: External monotonic elapsed time strictly positive
controlled_synthetic_protocol.demonstrative_rule: HIGH>=4/5; LOW<=1/5; otherwise INDETERMINATE. These are synthetic unit-test thresholds, not clinical cutoffs.
controlled_synthetic_protocol.source_of_labels: Fixture generator; NEVER patient data or retrospectively fitted thresholds
controlled_synthetic_protocol.informed_consent: No human enrollment; any future real research needs separate ethical review and consent
controlled_synthetic_protocol.cohorts: No real clinical or control cohort evaluated in R1

JANUS_RULE_001.note: This pinned commit establishes a research interpretation rule, not clinical authority.

next_scientific_gate: Independent preregistration of real participant research; obtain ethics/clinical approval and separately documented consent.
Use disjoint healthy-ageing, MCI, AD and relevant differential comparison groups only under authorized research design.
Check attention, vision, hearing, language, delirium/medications and testability as confounders.
Separate immediate awareness proxies, temporal order perception, delayed recall and first-person temporal phenomenology.
External assessor blinded to hypotheses and diagnosis status; no retrofitted cutoff selection.
Publish nulls, counterexamples, adverse events and full uncertainty; no diagnostic performance claims without reference standards.
